chunks: Muḥammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
The Muhrim may apply kohl to his eyes, if he wishes, with sabr, in which there is no saffron and no wars.

key_terms.الْمُحْرِمُ: a person in the state of ihram for hajj or 'umrah
key_terms.بِصَبِرٍ: with sabr, a type of aloe-based substance used medicinally or cosmetically
key_terms.زَعْفَرَانٌ: saffron, a fragrant substance excluded here
key_terms.وَرْسٌ: wars, a yellow dye or plant-based substance excluded here

ai.seo_question: Can a Muhrim apply kohl to the eyes during ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about what a Muhrim may use on the eyes during ihram. It permits applying kohl made with sabr, so long as it does not contain saffron or wars, indicating restrictions on scented or specific cosmetic substances in the state of ihram.
